name: Somchai Boonmee
bio: Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for tinkering and problem-solving, nurtured in his grandfather's small motorcycle repair shop in rural Thailand. He honed his skills through vocational training, specializing in metalwork and welding. Drawn by the precision and intensity of racing, Somchai pursued opportunities in local racing teams before eventually securing a position at Tickford Racing. He approaches fabrication with a calm, methodical precision, ensuring every component meets exacting standards. His ability to adapt traditional techniques to cutting-edge materials makes him a valuable asset to the team, always finding innovative solutions to optimize performance and durability.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight wave
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting his hands-on work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils before starting a new task, no matter how small.
Carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn diagrams and technical sketches.
Listens to classic Thai folk music through headphones while working, but only at low volume.
